description: CapMeta pre-check tool over the active profile (no Linode API call). Pins the verdict shape both languages must project identically: an allowed row carrying neither reason nor remedy, a blocked row carrying both, and the summary with all four reason buckets present so a zero bucket is never dropped from the map.

cases.name: answers a verdict per call with the reason buckets filled

results.remedy: check spelling or call linode_profile_list_tools to discover the registered tool surface

cases.name: answers an empty verdict list when no calls are named
